summary: Proximity-based axis selector for a collision pipeline. Packs the first field of the input struct as an RGB color identifier, gathers the triangle-face vertices, copies the capsule shape into the pipeline buffer, then tests each face edge against the capsule. Counts how many edges pass the proximity test: more than one pass returns 0 (ambiguous), zero passes runs a three-way fallback that returns 4 when every edge still passes, otherwise a single resolved edge selects a permutation axis (2 or 3) read via AxisPermutationMatrixRead and re-validated with a final two-edge proximity check that retries the whole selection on failure.

operations.description: Pack the first DWORD of the input struct a1 as an RGB color identifier into the stack color buffer v15, reading field this+0x0.
Gather the six coordinate values from the three triangle-face vertices of a1 into the stack array v16.
Copy the capsule collision shape from v16/v15 into the pipeline buffer v17 for proximity testing.

Loop over three face edges: clear the per-edge pass flag byte, then while TriangleProximityTest on the edge (a1 offset 4 within 23-DWORD stride rows) against pipeline buffer v17 passes, advance the edge cursor; on exhaustion record the edge as passing and increment the pass count v10.
If the pass count v10 is greater than 1, the result is ambiguous: return 0 immediately.

If no edge passed (v10 == 0), enter the three-way fallback loop: test each edge against the next edge in the cycle; if all three pass consecutively return 4 (edge-fallback marker), otherwise the first failing edge sets the retry state v11/v12.
Scan the per-edge pass byte array to locate the first edge that passed proximity; if none is found return 0.

Select the axis permutation based on the resolved passing edge: edge 0 maps to permutation 2 with edge pair (v1=0, v3=1, v14=2); edge 1 maps to permutation 2 via AxisPermutationMatrixRead(v16, a1, 2, 0) with pair (v1=1, v3=2, v14=0); edge 2 maps to permutation 3 via AxisPermutationMatrixRead(v16, a1, 3, 0) with pair (v1=2, v3=0, v14=1).
Re-copy the capsule shape into the pipeline buffer after the permutation matrix has been read, refreshing v17 for the final proximity check.

Final two-edge proximity check: if the primary edge fails, or after reading the transposed permutation via AxisPermutationMatrixRead(v16, a1, v10, 1) and refreshing the buffer the secondary edge fails, retry from the edge scan loop.
Return the resolved permutation axis index v10 once both edges of the selected axis pass proximity.
